title: Basket Random
description: The real Basket Random by RHM Interactive! Hilarious 2-on-2 ragdoll physics basketball with randomized bouncy balls, changing courts, outfits, and bouncy hoops. Solo vs CPU or 2-player local!
controls: P1: W or Tap | P2: Up Arrow or Tap | First to 5 points wins!

title: Smash Karts
description: The real Smash Karts 3D battle royale by Tall Team! Race into the arena, drift, grab mystery boxes, and eliminate opponents with homing rockets, spike mines, and cannons!
controls: WASD / Arrows to Drive | Space to Fire Weapon | Shift to Drift

title: Slope
description: The real 3D Slope game! Roll down an infinite, randomized neon slope dodging obstacles, red blocks, and narrow ramps at breakneck speeds.
controls: A/D or Left/Right Arrow keys to steer the ball

title: Retro Bowl
description: The real Retro Bowl by New Star Games! Be the boss of your NFL franchise, manage your roster, draft stars, and take the field in glorious 8-bit retro football.
controls: Click & drag with Mouse to aim and throw pass; tap to dive

title: Soccer Random
description: The real Soccer Random by RHM Interactive! Chaotic ragdoll soccer with changing weather, different bouncy balls, and funny physics. First to 5 goals wins!
controls: P1: W or Tap | P2: Up Arrow or Tap

title: Subway Surfers
description: The real Subway Surfers endless runner! Dash as fast as you can through subway tracks, dodge oncoming trains, and collect gold coins and hoverboards.
controls: Arrow keys / WASD: Left/Right to change lanes, Up to jump, Down to roll

description: Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile in this addictive puzzle game.
controls: Arrow keys or Swipe to slide tiles

title: Neon Snake
description: Slither around the grid eating energy orbs to grow longer. Don't hit the walls or yourself!
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate

title: Flappy Pixel
description: Flap your wings to dodge pipes and navigate through obstacles. How high can you score?
controls: Spacebar or Click / Tap to jump

title: Block Stacker
description: Drop and rotate tetromino shapes, clear horizontal lines, and set high scores in this classic stacker.
controls: Left/Right to move, Up/X to rotate, Space for hard drop, C to hold

title: T-Rex Runner
description: Sprint through the prehistoric desert, jump cacti, and duck under flying pterodactyls.
controls: Space or Up to jump, Down to duck, Tap on mobile

title: Pac-Chomper
description: Navigate neon maze corridors eating dots and power pellets while evading or hunting roaming ghosts.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to turn, or On-Screen D-Pad

title: Retro Breakout
description: Bounce the ball off your paddle to smash all colored bricks and trigger power-ups.
controls: Mouse or Left/Right arrows to move paddle

title: Cosmic Defender
description: Defend the galaxy against relentless alien waves and cosmic invaders.
controls: A/D or Left/Right to steer, Spacebar to fire lasers

title: Speed Word Defender
description: Type incoming space words to trigger laser defenses and protect your base from falling hazards.
controls: Type words on keyboard, press Enter to submit

title: Memory Match
description: Test your cognitive recall by flipping tiles to uncover and match identical pairs in minimum turns.
controls: Click or tap cards to flip and match

title: Cyber Pong
description: The arcade classic reimagined with crisp synthwave physics and adaptive CPU difficulty.
controls: Mouse or W/S to move paddle

title: Sky Jumper
description: Bounce on springs and platforms endlessly into the stratosphere. Avoid falling!
controls: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D

title: Grid Sweeper
description: Clear the minefield using deduction and numerical clues. Don't detonate the bombs!
controls: Left click to uncover, Right click to flag

title: Cookie Clicker
description: Click the giant chocolate chip cookie, hire baker grandmas, construct cookie farms, and trigger golden cookie frenzies!
controls: Click or tap the cookie to bake; purchase upgrades & buildings

title: Planet Clicker
description: Harvest cosmic energy from Earth, colonize the Moon and Mars, construct Dyson swarms, and intercept solar flares!
controls: Click or tap celestial planets to generate energy; build installations
